test: cypress/e2e/registration.cy.ts and profile.cy.ts (several tests after cy.visit)
observed: Intermittent, worse on slow or cold dev-server runs; the specs carried six 1 s waits and two 2.5 s waits 'for Svelte to settle' that sometimes were not enough.
error: AssertionError: Timed out retrying after 4000ms: expected '<div role="dialog">' to be visible  (after cy.contains('button', 'Delete account').click(); the click was reported as successful)
spec_before:
cy.visit('/profile')
// eslint-disable-next-line cypress/no-unnecessary-waiting -- Wait for Svelte page and HMR to settle
cy.wait(1000)
cy.contains('button', 'Delete account').click()
cy.get('[role="dialog"]').last().should('be.visible')
app_note: SvelteKit server-rendered pages; the root +layout.svelte runs its onMount after the page is painted; until then a click on a row opens no dialog and a form submits natively
